capabilities: Store API keys and settings for AI services in one place
Share provider settings with other plugins through an encapsulated SDK
Route generation, tool-calling, and embedding requests to local or remote providers
Cache embeddings and rank document chunks for vector-based retrieval
Declare per-model reasoning modes and capabilities via manual checkboxes and a Check probe
disambiguation: Not an AI chat or writing assistant itself; it is a control panel and API layer consumed by other plugins like Local GPT.
extras: Warns that requests already sent to a provider continue running and may incur charges, and that embedding cache misses re-send text and can cost money; installable via BRAT; UI available in 11 languages; developer integration docs live outside the README.
problem: Obsidian AI plugins each need their own provider configuration, so users must enter the same API keys and settings multiple times.

requires.name: Ollama / LM Studio / other local server

summary: Central settings hub and shared SDK that stores AI provider credentials and serves generation, tool-calling, and embedding requests to other plugins.
